function: Learns communication and sensing beam patterns (analog phase-shifter settings) of a massive-MIMO joint communication and sensing base station, with causal DRL that prunes irrelevant action dimensions (p. 2).
system: Massive-MIMO BS, 32 antennas plus 100 redundant dummy ones, analog quantized phase shifters, single-antenna users, no RIS; DeepMIMO O2_dyn_3p5, 0.5 GHz bandwidth, carrier not stated (p. 10).
method: Deep reinforcement learning: TD3 actor-critic with IC-INVASE selector network that prunes action dimensions (TD3-INVASE); one DRL agent per beam, K-means user clustering (pp. 5, 8).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing scenario O2_dyn_3p5 (Wireless InSite): 1000 snapshots at 100 ms, active BS 2, users 100 to 150; vehicle locations give sensing AoA (p. 9).
test_conditions: Training with BS tilt (0,0,0) and (0,30,0), then with 2 interferers and 2 clutter objects; testing on unseen BS tilts of 15 to 90 degrees per axis, no interference (p. 13).
baselines: Learned only: TD3 [29], WDDPG [20], ISAC-WDDPG [5], Interf-WDDPG [24]; no non-learned baseline is compared (p. 11).
metrics: Average reward, true positive rate of action selection, SIR, SCR, achievable data rate, probability of detection, and beamforming gain (p. 10).
openness: Code released at https://github.com/AnikRoy1997/CausalRLforJCAS (p. 11); channels come from the public DeepMIMO dataset (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "MIMO channel dataset obtained from benchmarking channel generation tool DeepMIMO"
q2_support: p. 13: "Our trained model has no knowledge about these datasets."
q3_support: p. 11: "the baselines TD3 for beamforming [29] (referred to as TD3), Wolpertinger strategy-based policy learning employed in [20] (referred to as WDDPG)". Not met: all baselines (TD3, WDDPG, ISAC-WDDPG, Interf-WDDPG) are learned RL methods; no non-learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 11: "achieving higher reward in fewer evaluations". Not met: only training sample efficiency and layer sizes (pp. 9-10) are given; no FLOPs, parameter count, big-O order or runtime.
q5_support: p. 11: "The code repository for our experiments has been made available at" footnote 1, https://github.com/AnikRoy1997/CausalRLforJCAS
notes: Area 5: learned beams of an ISAC base station, communication and sensing. q1 is DeepMIMO ray tracing, scenario O2_dyn_3p5. q2: Table 4 (p. 14) tests the trained model on unseen BS antenna tilts, and gain degrades at large tilts (p. 14); one tested tilt, (0,30,0), equals a training orientation. The text does not state the carrier frequency, only the scenario name and the 0.5 GHz bandwidth (p. 10).
